name: EXM_DELEGATIONS
description: This table contains the list of individuals and the persons they have authorized to enter expense reports on their behalf.

columns.name: DELEGATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a delegation authorization.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Unique person identifier of the individual who delegated expense entry.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique assignment identifier of the individual who delegated expense entry.

columns.name: DELEGATE_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Unique person identifier of the individual who is authorized to enter expense reports for another individual.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the delegate is authorized to enter expense reports for another individual.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the delegate can no longer enter expense reports for another individual.

columns.name: ENABLE_ACCOUNTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the individual who delegated expense entry can charge expenses to cost centers other than the default cost center.

columns.name: ENABLE_PROJECTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the individual who delegated expense entry can charge expenses to projects.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: INACTIVE_EMPLOYEE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a person is an inactive employee.

columns.name: DELEGATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Delegation Type is based on the non-extensible Lookup type, ORA_EXM_DELEGATION_TYPE.

columns.name: DELEGATION_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the delegation type, for example, if the type is Business Unit this column will have the BU_ID, if the type is Individual, this column will have the PERSON_ID.

columns.name: DELEGATION_ASSIGNMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the assignment based on the assignment type.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Free form text field for the manager to add any comments to the delegation.
